{{Top}}
[[File:Bacta_patch.png|thumb|right|250px|[[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] wearing a bacta patch]]

A '''bacta patch''', also called a '''bacta bandage''', was a disposable patch of [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] used to heal skin punctures<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide I: Onslaught">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide I: Onslaught]]''</ref> or damages in other parts of the body. Though not as effective as a full immersion in a [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tank]], bacta patches were much easier to [[Transport/Legends|transport]] and sufficed as a quick and convenient medical healer. They were useful when trying to keep a patient with more serious injuries stable until they could reach a bacta tank, but if there were no bacta tanks, then they were to have rested for a couple of days.<ref name="The Deserter">{{TCW|The Deserter}}</ref>

Bacta patches were small, and promoted the healing of damaged tissue. They were commonly found in [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
